title: leucanthemum rohlenae
intro: Leucanthemum rohlenae, commonly known as the Alpine Daisy, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum rohlenae include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
